name: context-menu-30
description: Password vault entries with copy username, copy password, and open site actions.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Asterisk as AsteriskIcon, ExternalLink as ExternalLinkIcon, KeyRound as KeyRoundIcon, RefreshCw as RefreshCwIcon, Trash as TrashIcon, User as UserIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" const entries = [ { site: "Figma", user: "ali@designali.com", strength: "Strong" }, { site: "Vercel", user: "designali", strength: "Weak" }, { site: "GitHub", user: "hello@designali.com", strength: "Strong" }, ] export default function PasswordVaultMenu() { const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(null) return (
{entries.map((entry) => (
{entry.site} {entry.user}
{entry.strength} setCopied("Username for " + entry.site)} > Copy username ⌘B setCopied("Password for " + entry.site)} > Copy password ⇧⌘C Open and fill Generate new password Move to trash ))}

{copied ? copied + " copied · clears in 30s" : "Right-click an item for quick actions"}

) }
